metadata.title: She Stole My Grandmother's Jade Ring
metadata.subtitle: His scheming secretary slipped on our cursed family ring to steal my throne—then her wrist turned ice-black at midnight.

nodes.text: 11:42 PM · Damian’s charity gala afterparty. Your phone buzzes with a photo Chloe posted to the company VIP group.
Damian said a real hostess deserves the family heirloom tonight. Sorry you had a "migraine", Brooke.
Take Grandmother’s blood-jade ring off right now. You broke into my locked mahogany cabinet to get that.
Stop making a scene in the group chat. I lent it to Chloe for the press photos. You’ll get it back tomorrow.
Madam, do not touch her hand when it turns black. Your grandmother bound that ring with a blood vow.

nodes.prompt: Chloe zooms in on the glowing crimson vein inside the jade:

options.label: Warn her about the midnight rule
options.player_reply_text: Anyone without my grandmother’s bloodline who wears that ring past midnight pays for it.

options.label: Ask Arthur to check the vault seal
options.player_reply_text: Arthur, did she tear off the yellow silk ribbon knotted beneath the ring?

nodes.text: Spare me the haunted-house fairy tale. Wait—why does this band suddenly feel like dry ice?
She tossed the silk ribbon in the fireplace, Madam! The cabinet mirror cracked the exact second it burned.
11:59 PM · Every chandelier in the ballroom flickers once. Chloe’s cocktail glass shatters in her left hand.
Damian help!! It’s shrinking!! My ring finger is turning purple-black and it won’t slide off!!

nodes.headline: Frost-Black at Midnight
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Chloe sends a close-up of the ring—and an antique seal burns into her skin.

nodes.text: 12:08 AM · Rain lashes the manor windows. Damian drags Chloe into the VIP powder room and grabs a pair of silver bolt cutters.

nodes.caption: Look at the dark halo spreading up my wrist!! Make it stop, Brooke!!

nodes.text: The steel jaws just snapped in half against the jade! What kind of trick did you pull on this ring?!
I didn’t touch it, Damian. Grandmother forged that jade to lock onto thieves who enter this house with greed.

nodes.prompt: Chloe begs you to come to the hotel before the press sees:

options.label: Ask what else she stole from me
options.player_reply_text: The ring only bites when a second theft is hidden in the same room. Empty your clutch, Chloe.

options.label: Tell Damian to check the mirror
options.player_reply_text: Don’t look at her hand, Damian. Look at the vanity mirror right behind Chloe’s left shoulder.

nodes.text: I didn’t take anything else! Wait—why is the brass key to your offshore safety box burning through my purse?!
God... there’s an old woman in a dark silk shawl standing in the reflection—holding a wooden ruler.

nodes.transcript: [sobbing, teeth chattering] "She’s whispering in my ear! She says I have until 3 AM to return every cent I stole!"

nodes.headline: The Reflection With a Ruler
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Damian finally asks what Chloe meant by "every cent".

nodes.text: 12:34 AM · Damian rushes Chloe into the private parking elevator to reach the ER. The doors shut—and the floor display freezes at B3.
The emergency button is dead. Chloe, why did you say you stole money?! Whose money?!
I was delirious from the cold! Stop asking me—the frost just reached my elbow!!
Madam, the elevator camera shows the cab temperature dropped to -4°C. Frost is spelling four digits on the steel wall: 1-8-0-0.

nodes.prompt: You recognize that exact figure from last quarter’s charity ledger:

options.label: Send the missing ledger figure
options.player_reply_text: $1.8 million went missing from my grandmother’s medical foundation last Tuesday, Damian. Ask your secretary where it went.

options.label: Trigger the voice-log playback
options.player_reply_text: Arthur, patch the study security audio straight into the elevator intercom.

nodes.text: Wait... Chloe told me YOU authorized that wire to an overseas clinic!
Patched in, Madam. The recording of Miss Chloe practicing your signature is playing on loop inside the cab now.
The speaker just stopped—and a voice whispered my grandmother’s maiden name! The doors are opening into an unlit floor!

nodes.headline: Floor B3 Does Not Exist
nodes.teaser_text: Next: This hotel only has two basement levels—so what is waiting outside the doors?

episodes.title: The Wooden Ruler in the Dark

nodes.text: 12:52 AM · Outside the stalled elevator, a damp corridor stretches into fog. Three sharp wooden raps echo against the marble.
Close the doors!! Close the doors!! Why is an antique rosewood chair sitting in the middle of the garage?!
That’s Grandmother’s ancestral hall chair. She only sits in it when someone in the house owes a confession.
I only took half, my brother needed it for his Macau gambling debt—I swear I was going to pay it back!
I saw what you just unsent, Chloe!! You framed my wife for a $1.8M theft to cover your brother’s gambling?!

nodes.prompt: Chloe drops to her knees as the jade ring glows blood-red:

options.label: Demand the forged audit folder
options.player_reply_text: Tell Damian where you hid the real bank vouchers, or you can explain it to the empty chair yourself.

options.label: Ask Arthur to lock the main gate
options.player_reply_text: Arthur, lock the estate gates and call the economic crimes unit. No one leaves until the audit clears.

nodes.text: It’s taped under the false bottom of my desk drawer!! Take it all—just make the footsteps stop!!
Already done, Madam. Detective Vance and two auditors are twelve minutes from the manor.
1:02 AM · The elevator lights slam back on. The chair vanishes—leaving a single wet footprint on the cab floor.

nodes.headline: The False Drawer
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Inside Chloe’s desk, Arthur finds something far worse than a forged signature.

nodes.text: 1:25 AM · Back at the manor, Arthur pries open the false panel in Chloe’s guest-office desk while Damian stands frozen in the doorway.
Madam, besides the forged transfer sheets, there are twelve unmarked packets of heavy sedatives labeled "Evening Chamomile".
That’s why I had a blinding "migraine" right before the gala. You brewed my tea tonight, didn’t you, Chloe?
It was only sleeping powder!! I just wanted you out of the gala so Damian would sign the charity restructuring!
You drugged my wife in our own home?! And I yelled at her in front of the whole board for skipping the gala?!

nodes.prompt: Chloe tries to bolt toward the terrace doors before police arrive:

options.label: Let the jade ring stop her
options.player_reply_text: Go ahead and touch the brass door handle, Chloe. Let’s see what Grandmother thinks of runners.

options.label: Reveal I never drank the tea
options.player_reply_text: I smelled the bitter almond note the second you left the room, Chloe. I poured the whole cup into a lab vial.

nodes.text: AAAH!! The ring just magnetized onto the brass lock! My arm is pinned to the door!!
The toxicology courier confirmed receipt an hour ago, Madam. Chain of custody is airtight.

nodes.transcript: [voice cracking] "Brooke... please come downstairs. I’m looking at the wire receipt on Chloe’s phone and I feel sick."

nodes.headline: Pinned to the Terrace Lock
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The overseas bank transfer reveals Chloe wasn’t acting alone.

nodes.text: 1:54 AM · Chloe’s unlocked phone slides across the oak table. A fresh bank confirmation pops up in bold green.

nodes.caption: Madam, look at the joint account holder on the Cayman wire. It is not just Miss Chloe’s brother.

nodes.text: Uncle Richard—Damian’s own CFO. That’s how Chloe bypassed the two-factor approval on my grandmother’s foundation.
Uncle Richard swore on my father’s grave he was auditing the foundation to protect it from YOU!

nodes.prompt: Uncle Richard calls Chloe’s phone right in front of everyone:

options.label: Put him on speakerphone silently
options.player_reply_text: Answer it on speaker, Damian. Don’t say a single word—let him hang himself.

options.label: Record the call for the prosecutor
options.player_reply_text: Hit record on the conference mic, Arthur. Detective Vance is walking up the driveway right now.

nodes.text: He just shouted on speaker: "Did the idiot wife sign the divorce papers yet? Wire my 40% before dawn!"
Every word recorded in crystal clarity, Madam. Even his confession about bribing the notary.
I’ll testify against Richard!! I’ll sign a full confession right now!! Please tell your grandmother to let my wrist go!!

nodes.headline: The Ring Loosens
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Police cuffs click shut—and only one person can lift the jade from Chloe’s finger.

nodes.text: 2:28 AM · Blue patrol lights sweep across the manor courtyard. Chloe signs a four-page sworn confession with her shaking right hand.
The moment her pen lifted off the confession page, the frost melted off her forearm and the jade ring slid loose onto the velvet tray.
I’m sorry, Brooke... I swear I’ll never touch anything that belongs to your family again.
Officers just arrested Uncle Richard at the private airfield too. Brooke, I was blind—can we talk upstairs?

nodes.prompt: Damian reaches for your hand near the grand staircase:

options.label: Hand him the divorce agreement
options.player_reply_text: You believed a thief over your wife in front of the entire city, Damian. My lawyer’s folder is on your pillow.

options.label: Claim the foundation chairmanship
options.player_reply_text: Keep your apologies. By sunrise, I’m reclaiming 100% control of Grandmother’s foundation—and you’re off the board.

nodes.text: No... please don’t throw away five years over one night. I’ll transfer my voting shares to your foundation!
The trustees have already ratified your emergency chairmanship, Madam. Your grandmother’s legacy is safe.
The rain finally clears. In the quiet hall, the blood-jade ring glows with a gentle, warm amber sheen.

nodes.headline: The True Heir
nodes.teaser_text: Finale: Morning sunlight fills Grandmother’s pavilion as a new chapter begins.

nodes.text: 8:15 AM · Golden morning light spills across Grandmother’s lotus pavilion. You slide the warm blood-jade ring back onto your finger.
Good morning, Chairwoman Brooke. Every cent of the $1.8M has been frozen and returned to the medical foundation.
Thank you, Arthur. Brew fresh jasmine tea—no chamomile ever again.
I signed the uncontested settlement and left the penthouse keys with Arthur. I hope one day you can forgive me.

nodes.prompt: You look down at the calm, warm jade catching the morning sun:

options.label: Sip your tea and step into the sun
options.player_reply_text: The past stays behind that locked door. Today belongs to me.

options.label: Dedicate the new hospital wing
options.player_reply_text: Arthur, call the architects. We’re naming the new children’s wing after Grandmother.

nodes.text: A warm breeze ripples the lotus pond. The blood-jade rests softly against your skin—quiet, steady, and finally home.
Arthur bows with a proud smile as morning bells chime softly across the garden.

nodes.headline: Crown of Jade
nodes.teaser_text: You finished "She Stole My Grandmother’s Jade Ring"! Explore more karma thrillers.
